title: Merge staged contacts

spec.text: Nightly import merges staging_contacts into contacts, matching on case-insensitive email. Staging can hold the same email several times; keep the most recently updated row. Existing contacts are only overwritten when the staged row is newer.

context: PostgreSQL 15. contacts.email_key is text with a UNIQUE constraint and holds lower(trim(email)). staging_contacts has a serial id and NOT NULL updated_at, but no other constraints. Rows without an email are handled by a separate report.

files.content:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    lower(trim(email)) AS email_key,
    trim(email)        AS email,
    full_name,
    phone,
    updated_at,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY lower(trim(email))
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM staging_contacts
  WHERE email IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(email) <> ''
)
INSERT INTO contacts (email_key, email, full_name, phone, updated_at)
SELECT email_key, email, full_name, phone, updated_at
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ON CONFLICT (email_key) DO UPDATE
SET email      = EXCLUDED.email,
    full_name  = EXCLUDED.full_name,
    phone      = EXCLUDED.phone,
    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
WHERE contacts.updated_at < EXCLUDED.updated_at;
